_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: <notificationId>-R<nnn>

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mast_site.name

notificationId.description: Reference to u_mes_syst_notification._id: the parent document this one belongs to

notificationName.description: Display value of notificationId, copied from u_mes_syst_notification.title

sequenceNo.description: Position of this document in its list (within the same parent for child collections), starting at 1

userName.description: Display value of userId, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

roleName.description: Display value of roleId, copied from u_mes_mast_role.name

sentAt.description: Date and time when the record was sent

deliveredAt.description: Date and time when the record was delivered

readAt.description: Date and time when the record was read

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1

createdAt.description: Date and time the document was created

createdById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user or process that created the document

createdBy.description: Display name of the creator, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

updatedAt.description: Date and time of the most recent update

updatedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user or process that last updated the document

updatedBy.description: Display name of the last updater, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName
